nodes.title: Random Variables: Discrete vs Continuous
points: Random Variable (X): A real-valued function whose domain is the sample space S of a random experiment (X: S → ℝ).
Discrete Random Variable: Takes a finite or countably infinite set of values (e.g., number of heads in 3 coin tosses, defective bulbs in a sample).
Continuous Random Variable: Takes any real value in an interval [a, b] (e.g., height, temperature, time, lifespan of a battery).
Range of random variable: Set of all possible values taken by X.

nodes.title: Probability Mass Function (PMF)
points: For a discrete random variable X taking values x₁, x₂, ..., xₙ with probabilities p₁, p₂, ..., pₙ:
Conditions for a valid PMF P(X = x):
1. Non-negativity: P(X = x_i) = p_i ≥ 0 for all i.
2. Total Probability: ∑_(i=1)ⁿ p_i = 1.
Probability Distribution: Tabular representation listing each value x_i alongside its probability P(X = x_i).

nodes.title: Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) - Discrete
points: Definition: F(x) = P(X ≤ x) = ∑_(x_i ≤ x) P(X = x_i).
Properties of CDF F(x):
1. 0 ≤ F(x) ≤ 1 for all x.
2. F(x) is a non-decreasing step function.
5. Individual probability: P(X = x_i) = F(x_i) − F(x_(i−1)).

nodes.title: Expected Value (Mean) of Discrete RV
points: Expected Value / Mean (μ or E[X]): Measure of central tendency of the probability distribution:
E[X] = μ = ∑_(i=1)ⁿ x_i · P(X = x_i) = ∑ x_i p_i.
Properties of Expectation:
1. E[c] = c (where c is constant).
2. E[aX + b] = a E[X] + b.
Second Moment: E[X²] = ∑ x_i² p_i.

nodes.title: Variance and Standard Deviation
points: Variance V(X) or σ²: Measure of dispersion of X around its mean:
V(X) = E[(X − μ)²] = E[X²] − (E[X])² = ∑ x_i² p_i − (∑ x_i p_i)².
Standard Deviation (σ): σ = +√V(X).
Properties of Variance:
1. V(X) ≥ 0 ALWAYS (Variance can never be negative!).
2. V(c) = 0 for constant c.
3. V(aX + b) = a² V(X) (Shift of origin has NO effect; scaling is squared!).
4. Standard Deviation: SD(aX + b) = |a| SD(X).

nodes.title: Probability Density Function (PDF) - Continuous
points: For a continuous random variable X, probability is defined by a density function f(x).
Conditions for a valid PDF f(x):
1. Non-negativity: f(x) ≥ 0 for all x ∈ (−∞, ∞).
2. Total Area = 1: ∫_(−∞)^∞ f(x) dx = 1.
Probability in an interval [a, b]:
P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = ∫_a^b f(x) dx = Area under PDF curve from a to b.
CRITICAL PROPERTY: For a continuous RV, probability at any SINGLE EXACT POINT IS ZERO: P(X = c) = ∫_c^c f(x) dx = 0.
Consequently: P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = P(a < X ≤ b) = P(a ≤ X < b) = P(a < X < b).

nodes.title: CDF of Continuous Random Variable
points: Cumulative Distribution Function: F(x) = P(X ≤ x) = ∫_(−∞)^x f(t) dt.
Properties: F(−∞) = 0, F(∞) = 1; 0 ≤ F(x) ≤ 1.
Interval Probability from CDF: P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = F(b) − F(a).
Fundamental Link between PDF and CDF: f(x) = d/dx[F(x)] = F'(x) (PDF is the derivative of CDF).

nodes.title: Mean and Variance of Continuous RV
points: Expected Value (Mean): E[X] = μ = ∫_(−∞)^∞ x · f(x) dx.
Second Moment: E[X²] = ∫_(−∞)^∞ x² · f(x) dx.
Variance: V(X) = E[X²] − (E[X])².
Uniform Distribution on [a, b]: f(x) = 1/(b − a) for a ≤ x ≤ b ⟹ Mean = (a + b)/2; Variance = (b − a)² / 12.

nodes.title: Must-Know Board Questions & Verification Problems
points: Board Favourite #1: Find unknown constant k if P(X = x) = k x for x = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 is a valid PMF (use ∑ p_i = 1 ⟹ k(1+2+3+4+5) = 1 ⟹ k = 1/15).
Board Favourite #2: Find k if f(x) = k x (1 − x) for 0 ≤ x ≤ 1 is a valid PDF (use ∫₀¹ f(x) dx = 1 ⟹ k = 6).
Board Favourite #3: Given probability distribution table, calculate Mean E[X] and Variance V(X).
Board Favourite #4: Find CDF F(x) from given PMF/PDF and evaluate P(X < 3), P(1 ≤ X ≤ 4).
Board Verification Tip: Always verify that all probabilities are non-negative (p_i ≥ 0) before applying ∑ p_i = 1.

nodes.title: MHT-CET Shortcuts, Variance Scaling & Traps
points: Variance Scaling Shortcut: V(2X + 3) = 2² V(X) = 4 V(X). V(−3X + 5) = (−3)² V(X) = 9 V(X).
Standard Deviation Shortcut: SD(aX + b) = |a| SD(X). SD(−2X + 7) = 2 SD(X).
Continuous Point Trap: If X is continuous, P(X = 2) = 0 strictly! Never waste time integrating for single-point continuous probability.
Variance Sanity Check: If your calculated E[X²] < (E[X])², your calculation is WRONG, because V(X) cannot be negative.
Coin Toss PMF: Number of heads X in n coin tosses follows B(n, ½); Mean = n/2, Variance = n/4.
